$comment: Every score CipherWeave emits, declared against contracts/score_envelope.json (vendored from ContextWeave). tests/test_score_contract.py holds this file to the contract and resolves every producer.

scores.name: cipherweave.path_risk
scores.evidence: evidence_mass S and the paths that contributed to it (RiskAggregate)
scores.meaning: r = 1 - exp(-S) over graph evidence (Eq. 2). Monotone in the evidence mass and bounded; not a probability of compromise. Order on S when comparisons must stay strict.

scores.name: cipherweave.drift_delta
scores.evidence: window_size: decisions in the trailing window
scores.meaning: max over per-channel standardised deviations (Eq. 3, plus the extended channels when enabled), compared with theta. Unbounded above; a z-like score, not a probability. 0 with cold_start=true means no baseline, not no drift.
